title: Scotland sees drop in major pathogen reports
summary:
Figures from Scotland show reports of most pathogens declined in 2025 while 10 outbreaks were recorded.

There were decreases in laboratory-confirmed reports of Campylobacter, Cryptosporidium, Hepatitis A and E, Listeria monocytogenes, norovirus, E. coli, and non-typhoidal Salmonella, according to Public Health Scotland (PHS).

title: Tomato restrictions eased in Italy after Salmonella concerns
summary:
An Italian region has lifted restrictions on the use of most fresh tomatoes in food service.

Officials in Foggia said raw tomatoes can now be served unless they come from Caltanissetta or Ragusa. The change was made based on the updated epidemiological situation and guidance from the regional health authority.
